events.evidence: Senior members of the United States Congress agree on a legislative deal to bail out the U.S. financial system from lingering effects of the subprime mortgage crisis
Jobless claims in the United States rise to a seven-year high while orders for durable goods fall to their lowest level in 18 months
Home sales in the United States during August 2008 fall to a 17-year low

label.note: Congress bailout deal is supportive, but weak jobs, durable goods, and home sales dominate.
